component.name: Shanti Keyboard
component.summary: An OpenSource, Unicode compliant Bengali Input Method

description.p: Shanti Keyboard is an OpenSource, Unicode compliant Bengali Input Method for GNU/Linux systems. It provides Avro Phonetic, Probhat, Munir Optima, National (Jatiya), and other layouts together with typing automation tools.
This experimental fork focuses on a portable, user-local Linux build and installation workflow.
